title: Shopping Cart Management
key_classes: CartService (interface) — 7 methods: addProductToCart, updateProductToCart, getAllCartItems, getCartCount, getCartItemCount, removeProductFromCart, removeAProduct
CartServiceImpl (implements CartService) — JDBC-based, uses DBUtil, table: usercart(username, prodid, quantity)
CartBean (Serializable entity) — fields: userId:String, prodId:String, quantity:int
relationships: AddtoCart depends_on ProductServiceImpl (getProductDetails for stock check)
AddtoCart depends_on DemandServiceImpl (registers demand when out of stock)
UpdateToCart depends_on ProductServiceImpl (getProductDetails for stock check)
UpdateToCart depends_on DemandServiceImpl (registers demand when out of stock)
CartServiceImpl depends_on ProductServiceImpl (internal stock check in addProductToCart)
CartServiceImpl creates CartBean (populates from usercart ResultSet)

use_case_details.name: Add Product to Cart
use_case_details.flow: Session auth check → get prodId+pQty from request → CartServiceImpl.getProductCount(userId, prodId) → if pQty==cartQty: removeProductFromCart; if availableQty < pQty: cap+demand registration; else: updateProductToCart(userId, prodId, pQty)

use_case_details.name: Update Cart Quantity
use_case_details.flow: Session auth check → get prodId+pQty from request → ProductServiceImpl.getProductDetails → if availableQty < pQty: cap+demand; else: CartServiceImpl.updateProductToCart(userId, prodId, pQty)

use_case_details.name: Remove Product from Cart
use_case_details.flow: Select from usercart → decrement quantity by 1 → if qty>0: UPDATE; if qty<=0: DELETE row
use_case_details.also: removeAProduct(userId, prodId) — hard DELETE without decrement

use_case_details.name: View Cart Items
use_case_details.flow: SELECT * FROM usercart WHERE username=? → returns List<CartBean>

use_case_details.name: Get Cart Item Count
service_methods: CartServiceImpl.getCartCount(userId) — SELECT sum(quantity) FROM usercart WHERE username=?
CartServiceImpl.getCartItemCount(userId, itemId) — SELECT quantity WHERE username=? AND prodid=?
CartServiceImpl.getProductCount(userId, prodId) — SELECT sum(quantity) WHERE username=? AND prodid=?

use_case_details.name: Register Demand (Out of Stock)
use_case_details.trigger: Invoked from AddtoCart or UpdateToCart when requested qty exceeds available stock
use_case_details.flow: DemandServiceImpl.addProduct(new DemandBean(userName, prodId, excessQty)) → email notification to customer

important_notes: Session guard: AddtoCart checks username+password+usertype=='customer'; UpdateToCart checks only username+password
updateProductToCart handles INSERT (new) and UPDATE (existing) and DELETE (qty=0) — used as upsert
Direct instantiation (no DI): servlets instantiate CartServiceImpl, ProductServiceImpl, DemandServiceImpl with new
No separate 'view cart' servlet found — getAllCartItems likely called from cartDetails.jsp directly or another servlet
Demand registration is a cross-cutting include from both Add and Update flows when stock is insufficient
